status: prototype: one stretch on the staging export only (2026-09-22); nothing full-scale until the owner has flown it
supersedes: data/rift.json and tools/rift_build.py (the first pass: a rim wall and spires; it read as a fence)

stretch.why: The deepest stretch of the trunk (depth 45-63 on the heightmap, rims y137-151), clear of every settlement, with an outside vantage on the east rim at the Patriarch of the Wedge and a 3,000-block sightline from the hometown.

scarp.why: The walls average 13-22 degrees (steepest 4-block step 45): a valley. The lip becomes a sheer riser (23+ blocks is a lethal drop), then shattered steps and tilted plates to the floor. Cut only: the rim and the floor edge stay where they are, so nothing on the floor or the plateau moves.

rim.why: The owner, 2026-09-22: what worked in the first pass was height seen from far away; give that without spacing or regularity. The torn edges are shoved up into jagged crags and tilted slabs, 8-20 thick so Distant Horizons draws them. Each side of the Rift varies along its length: crags, the sheer drop, broken plates.

peaks.why: a handful of much higher peaks at the forbidding stretches; the apex gets the most when the full Rift is built. In this stretch, on the higher east rim

seams.why: the veins climb through some upthrust faces: violet and crying obsidian

entrances.why: The rim post's descent is a gate (owner, 2026-09-22): a switchback down the scarp through a gap in the crags, the guard at the trailhead in the open. The rim post's own rim_trail plan crosses this stretch and is superseded here until it is re-planned.

caps.why: Every crack deeper than one block is capped at ground level, so nothing that walks falls in (owner, 2026-09-22). Purple stained glass where the glow should light the surface; tinted glass, which blocks light, only where darkness is the point. Neither conditions a spawn.

seal.why: The first prototype's cuts opened caves behind the new faces and water ran in. Every void within 3 blocks behind a new surface is made rock at run time (fill ... replace #cobblers:rift_void), as the Displaced City cavern's shell does; nothing reads the world to decide.

waterfalls.why: One deliberate fall off the highest sheer lip, where it looks best; everything else is sealed.
waterfalls.spawn_policy_exception: minecraft:water conditions 84 species (data/spawn_blocks.json). The Rift's spawn pools are exclusive and curated, and none of their entries needs water, so the fall decides no encounter there. Recorded here as the one deliberate exception.

face_upper.why: the torn edge of our world: its own rock, in bands

face_lower.why: deeper down, the other world bleeds through

tread.why: the shattered plates near the floor

vein_core.why: mint-white, light 15: a crystal standing in the crack's slot, not a flat tile. Sea lanterns read as a tiled path the owner recognised (2026-09-22)

vein_bed.why: violet, light 15: the glow one block down in the crack

vein_halo.why: violet-pink, light 15, a full cube: the seams up the faces

vein_seep.why: light 10 and purple drips where the vein thins

wound_crust.why: glass over light: depth, and colour at range

crystal.why: where the energy crystallised, at the veins' branch points

never.why: each conditions a spawn (data/spawn_blocks.json): Glimmet and Glimmora, Varoom, Gible, and the gem species

sky_crack.why: Candidate only (decision 2): a sample over this stretch to judge from 3,000 blocks. Every part 8 thick or more, so Distant Horizons draws it.

portal_sheets.use: glimpses only: two sheets deep in a narrow tear in a solid face, the rock hiding every edge, and one pool lying in the wound. Never standing in the open, never in a fissure (owner, 2026-09-22)
portal_sheets.why: Display entities showing the nether portal texture: no teleport, no collision. Not seen beyond entity render distance, so only where the tear is still open, close up.

biome.paint: every 4x4 biome cell whose 16 columns all lie inside the lip, and nothing outside it
biome.spawns: Ships only with the spawn change in docs/mechanics/RIFT_FRACTURE.md: the 40 data/spawns.json entries scoped to rift_trunk, rift_west_spur, rift_south_west_arm and rift_south_east_arm add cobblers:the_rift to their biomes, and the pools are recompiled (2,120 compiled spawns). Staging has no pools installed.
